def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers_list = instance["customer_ids"]
    if not customers_list:
        return []
    customers = set(customers_list)
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    hint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", len(customers_list))

    # --- Clarke-Wright savings initialization (feasibility-first) ---
    routes = [[c] for c in customers_list]
    route_of = {}
    for rid, c in enumerate(customers_list):
        route_of[c] = rid

    def route_load(route):
        s = 0
        for x in route:
            s += demands[x]
        return s

    loads = [demands[c] for c in customers_list]

    # Precompute savings list deterministically (tie-break by pair ids)
    # saving(i,j) = d(d,i)+d(d,j)-d(i,j)
    savings = []
    dep_to = matrix[depot]
    for a_i in range(len(customers_list)):
        i = customers_list[a_i]
        di = dep_to[i]
        for a_j in range(a_i + 1, len(customers_list)):
            j = customers_list[a_j]
            s = di + dep_to[j] - matrix[i][j]
            # store with deterministic tie-break
            savings.append((s, i, j))
    savings.sort(key=lambda t: (-t[0], t[1], t[2]))

    # Merge routes when endpoints match and capacity allows
    for _, i, j in savings:
        ra = route_of.get(i, None)
        rb = route_of.get(j, None)
        if ra is None or rb is None or ra == rb:
            continue

        ra_route = routes[ra]
        rb_route = routes[rb]
        if not ra_route or not rb_route:
            continue

        ai0 = ra_route[0]
        ai1 = ra_route[-1]
        bj0 = rb_route[0]
        bj1 = rb_route[-1]

        # Try four endpoint merge orientations with possible reversal
        # Case 1: i at end of A, j at start of B => A + B
        if i == ai1 and j == bj0:
            new_load = loads[ra] + loads[rb]
            if new_load <= capacity:
                routes[ra] = ra_route + rb_route
                loads[ra] = new_load
                routes[rb] = []
                for x in routes[ra]:
                    route_of[x] = ra
                # Small heuristic: if we already have <= hint, keep merging but don't overdo.
        # Case 2: i at start of A, j at end of B => reverse A + B
        elif i == ai0 and j == bj1:
            new_load = loads[ra] + loads[rb]
            if new_load <= capacity:
                ra_rev = list(reversed(ra_route))
                routes[ra] = ra_rev + rb_route
                loads[ra] = new_load
                routes[rb] = []
                for x in routes[ra]:
                    route_of[x] = ra
        # Case 3: i at end of A, j at end of B => A + reverse(B)
        elif i == ai1 and j == bj1:
            new_load = loads[ra] + loads[rb]
            if new_load <= capacity:
                rb_rev = list(reversed(rb_route))
                routes[ra] = ra_route + rb_rev
                loads[ra] = new_load
                routes[rb] = []
                for x in routes[ra]:
                    route_of[x] = ra
        # Case 4: i at start of A, j at start of B => reverse(A) + reverse(B)? (make i before j)
        elif i == ai0 and j == bj0:

            if new_load <= capacity:
